The *Lomasakaṅgiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 550) is a verse text belonging to the Therāpadāna collection of the Pali Canon [Catalog; SuttaCentral]. It recounts the past lives and spiritual attainments of the elder Lomasakaṅgiya. SuttaCentral records five modern translations of the text in five languages [SuttaCentral]. The text is intimately tied to the canonical *Bhaddekaratta* discourse group; SuttaCentral notes connections between this apadāna and several related texts, including the *Bhaddekaratta Sutta* (MN 131), *Ānandabhaddekaratta Sutta* (MN 132), *Mahākaccānabhaddekaratta Sutta* (MN 133), *Lomasakaṅgiyabhaddekaratta Sutta* (MN 134), and the *Sāsanapaṭṭhāna* of the *Nettippakaraṇa* (Ne 37) [SuttaCentral].
